title: When the Well Turns
author: Casper Ashgrove
blurb: Emrys Thackeray, a pest controller called to something with fingerprints, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. Then all the photographs from grandma's house now include an extra chair — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must return what was taken in 1974, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
